info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Counterparty Risk Management API
info.description: The Counterparty Risk Management API enables financial institutions to dynamically assess and update risk profiles associated with counterparties. This endpoint allows for the modification of risk details, ensuring accurate and timely risk assessments. Typical consumers include risk management teams and compliance officers who need to maintain up-to-date information to mitigate potential financial risks. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their decision-making processes and strengthen their risk management frameworks.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the counterparty risk details for a specific party identified by PARTY-600045. Ensure that you provide the necessary data in the request body for a successful update.

requestBody.description: Updates the counterparty risk details for a specific party identified by PARTY-600045. This request body should include the necessary fields to modify the existing counterparty risk data.
